create_tagdesc_template: create a TagDesc template object that generates random adjective tags like bright or round for dialogue generation
generate_tag_description: generate a tag description string from a TagDesc instance using the generate_description method
create_tagname_template: create a TagName template object that generates random tag names like big spider or red box
generate_tag_name: generate a tag name with article prefix from a TagName instance using the generate_description method
review_tag_map: review the tag_map dictionary that maps colour, size, and tag keys to their respective constant lists
